description: Fetch a LinkedIn profile: full_name, headline, about, location, follower_count, connection_count, current_company, experience, education and skills. With `detail=with_email`, also look for their work email, each address checked with its mail server. Use this to enrich a person from their profile URL. Give exactly one of `url` or `vanity_name`. Costs 11 credits (7 for `detail=main`, 33 for `detail=with_email`), cached or not; a failed call is refunded.

detail.description: `main` is the profile as LinkedIn first shows it, without opening a section: up to 5 positions, 2 schools and 2 skills, for less. `with_email` is the whole profile and a search for their work email, in `emails`, for more.

fresh.description: Skip the cache and fetch now. Charged normally. Not available on trial credits — buy any pack to unlock it.

url.description: The public profile URL, e.g. `https://www.linkedin.com/in/someone`. A member-id URL (`/in/ACoAA…` or `/in/ACwAA…`), as reactions and Sales Navigator give, works too.

vanity_name.description: The part after `/in/` in the public URL, e.g. `someone`. A member id (`ACoAA…`) works too.

name: get_linkedin_profile
title: Get a LinkedIn profile
